# Kogen

## Install

Sign in with any one of these routes:

```sh
kogen provider login chatgpt   # browser
printf '%s' "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" | kogen provider login anthropic
printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_CODE_TOKEN" | kogen provider login claude-code
```

# Kogen

Kogen takes one requested feature through shaping, building, verifying, reviewing and committing, in your own Git repository.

## Use

Sign in with any one of these routes:

```sh
kogen provider login chatgpt   # browser
printf '%s' "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" | kogen provider login anthropic
printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_CODE_TOKEN" | kogen provider login claude-code
```
files.docs/getting-started.md:
# Getting started

## 3. Log in

Sign in with any one route. `kogen init` discovery works with any signed-in route.

```sh
kogen provider login chatgpt   # browser
printf '%s' "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" | kogen provider login anthropic
printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_CODE_TOKEN" | kogen provider login claude-code
```

## 4. Initialise the project

`kogen init` discovery works with any signed-in route.

`ok models - shape, build, review ready` means the next command is `kogen intent shape <slug> <request-file>`.

Without ChatGPT is the optional hand-written path.
